scope: Section 3 own property declarations and own explicit allowed values only; inherited copies excluded; unplaced-property appendix excluded; current non-draft/non-archived Core R sources only.
interpretation: Covered means at least one current R defines or requires the property/value in content, not necessarily that its existing governs is the candidate name. Missing is a missing R definition in the scanned scope, not proof of absence of M/D rules. Uncertain items require meaning clarification; do not create adopted semantics from this report. A supporting R may cover multiple properties in its content; lack of exact governs is not permission to retarget that R to every covered field. Map its actual governed meaning once.

content_conflicts.issue: Current base Status rule requires one Status but declares no universal allowed set. Role-specific lists cannot be broadened to Atom merely by changing Subjects.
Exact source domain excludes inherited Draft. Existing role additions Backlog/Canceled/Done are covered separately.
Exact source domain excludes inherited Active; Done itself is covered.
Exact source domain uses lowercase draft/active/resolved/canceled and excludes inherited Archived.
Current qualified domain rules prohibit a global override and qualify extensions. Candidate universal additive inheritance requires content alignment.

Container-related R text still describes non-Atom collections despite Container Atom Subjects; no current R declares proposed Boolean capability/default. Subject-only rename cannot make non-Atoms into Atoms.
R1576 covers Labels, but R1577 still defines separate Plan authoring Subtypes although its Subject is Label. Later content pass must resolve; no duplicate Label definition needed.

R1342 currently places Carrier definitions/classification in D even without concrete format/location. New demand for R for every entity conflicts with that rule; report missing R without reclassifying D by Subject rename.
